prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Asset type: photorealistic square catalog product image for a fictional Compact dual-pulley station in Home Gym Creator.
Input image 1 is EQUIPMENT FORM REFERENCE ONLY: preserve the recognizable complete compact cable station layout, not the manufacturer's identity. Input image 2 is CATALOG STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its graphite steel, restrained orange accents, warm off-white studio background, photographic lighting and realism; do not copy the rack equipment.
Create one exceptionally realistic manufactured compact dual-pulley functional trainer. Two tall front brushed-steel adjustment rails with regular holes, one mechanically credible adjustable swivel pulley carriage on each rail, each with a black cable, metal carabiner and hanging individual black D-handle. Upper structural frame includes an ergonomic multi-grip pull-up bar. Rear central selectorized resistance stack enclosure, neatly routed continuous cables around real pulley wheels, splayed stable steel base feet with rubber pads. Preserve open exercise space between front rails. This is a complete station, not a rack attachment or single-column machine. Cable carriages at upper-chest height. All components connected plausibly, real bolts, welds, brackets and metal thicknesses. Fine textured graphite powder coat, brushed steel rails, black cables and handles; small muted orange adjustment knobs and carriage accents consistent with the catalog reference. Original unbranded enclosure with subtle perforation, no copied exercise charts.
Style: premium real studio product photography, not a simplified 3D render, not illustration. Soft large diffused studio lights, natural metal reflections, sharp realistic texture, gentle floor contact shadow, warm off-white seamless floor/background.
Composition: square canvas, entire single station centered, front three-quarter view with modest side visibility and straight verticals, all feet and pull-up bar fully visible, comfortable margins, product fills about 85 percent of canvas height.
Avoid: people, gym room, benches, barbells, weight plates, extra equipment, logos, brand names, exercise charts, text, labels, watermark, measurements, distorted geometry, disconnected cables, floating components. Do not suggest certified dimensions, load ratings or anchoring safety. Generate one image.
review: Visually inspected: two front adjustment rails and pulley carriages, individual handles, upper multi-grip pull-up bar, rear enclosure and splayed feet retained. Graphite finish, restrained orange accents, full object on warm off-white background; no visible manufacturer branding. AI-generated concept, not a photograph of an existing manufactured product or evidence of cable routing, safe anchoring, resistance channels, dimensions or load ratings.
